title: Ngeli ya A-WA (Theme 4: Dira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows A-WA is the class of people and animals and gives one person a- and many wa-.
representations: picture cards of people and animals
a table: mtoto anacheza / watoto wanacheza
steps: Is it a person or an animal?
Check the verb and the adjective agree.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Mtoto anacheza" and "Watoto wanacheza".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Watoto wawili ___naimba." Kwa nini "a" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za ngeli ya A-WA hutumia a- kwa umoja na wa- kwa wingi: mtoto anaimba, watoto wanaimba.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ndege watatu ___naruka juu." Kwa nini "zi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Watu na wanyama wote wako katika ngeli ya A-WA: paka anaruka, ndege wanaruka.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya A-WA?" Kwa nini "kitabu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ngeli ya A-WA ni ya watu na wanyama. Kitabu ni kitu, kiko katika ngeli ya KI-VI.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtoto mmoja, ___ wawili." Kwa nini "vitoto" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa mtoto ni watoto, wa mwalimu ni walimu: m- hubadilika kuwa wa-.
